title: fix(spec): reword the CurrencyConfigSchema.precision clause in two major-18 D3 entries
body:
Fixes #20379

Clause-②: no

## What

Reworded ONLY the `CurrencyConfigSchema.precision` clause in the two major-18 D3 migration entries that `os migrate meta` prints to authors:

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.field-scale-precision-integer-refused.ts`
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-form-field-precision-scale-integer-refused.ts`

Both said `CurrencyConfigSchema.precision` is "unchanged" — false in this same major now that `currency-config-precision-removed` (D3 `currency-config-precision-retired`) retires that key. Round 1, after the at-tier FAIL `5875601370`: the form-field entry's gantt `scale` clause was itself false, because `GanttConfigSchema` declares no `scale` (its granularity key is `viewMode`). That clause now names the timeline view's `scale` enum (`TimelineConfigSchema.scale`) and says the gantt view has no `scale` key. No tracker number was added to either clause (runtime/author-shown text carries none). Regenerated `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` with `gen:migration-registry` so the printed text matches. Added a `patch` changeset (`.changeset/20379-currency-precision-d3-text.md`) since this text ships inside the published `dist`.

No schema, key, conversion or verdict changes.

## Verification record

Round 0 HEAD `db7ad5204f` (round 1 HEAD `1cbd8ea52f`, re-measured in the round-1 report `5876206709` on #20379), merge-base `8e0285918` of `origin/main`. `origin/main` fetched at `4b2d904190` before opening this PR — no commit since the base touches `packages/spec/src/migrations/**`, so no merge was needed.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` — clean; `check-dts-emitted` 36/36, `check-dts-references` 394/394 resolved.
- Positive control: confirmed the reworded sentence (not the old "unchanged" claim) is what ships, by grepping `packages/spec/dist/index.js` / `dist/index.mjs` for the new wording — 2 hits, one per entry; the old false sentence appears nowhere in `dist`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` — 570 test files, 16741 tests passed, 1 todo, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:scripts-typecheck` + `check:test-typecheck`) — exit 0; the test-typecheck debt ledger unchanged (251 pre-existing pinned errors, shrink-only, none new).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`, reconciled with `--ran`: **82 derived, 81 run/green, 1 NOT MEASURED** (`pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` — its own prerequisite check refuses with exit 3, "PREREQUISITE NOT MET", naming ~86 packages across the whole monorepo that need `pnpm build` first; dispatch-gates independently classifies the CI job that owns this population, `Build Core`'s "Build packages" step, as having no local invocation — full-tree build is CI's to run, not proportionate to this 3-file, zero-export/schema-shape diff). Two gates needed cheap prerequisite builds before they could run for real, both then green: `check:doc-formula-expressions` (needed `@objectstack/formula` + `@objectstack/lint` built) and `check:lean-entry-closure` (needed `@objectstack/objectql` built).

## Acceptance notes

Hypothesis-4 grep sweep (`CurrencyConfigSchema.precision` + `unchanged`, repo-wide) found two more hits beyond the two entries fixed here — both resolved without action, no third fix needed:

- `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:13763` also pairs the two terms, but it sits under the already-shipped `## 17.1.0` heading (the #8321 field-scale/precision entry) — release-frozen text (AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails: never hand-edit `CHANGELOG.md` in a code PR), and it was true when published (this major's retirement postdates 17.1.0).
- `.changeset/19992-currency-config-precision-retired.md` also contains "unchanged" near "precision", but it correctly refers to the FIELD-level `precision` key (total digit count), not `CurrencyConfigSchema.precision` — no false claim.
